struct-output.rs.reason: core SyncView shape: a user FnOnce impl for a struct names its own Self::Output, F::Output, in its call_once signature; a use normalizes it through the user impl

reference-output.rs.reason: core array Drain shape: a user FnOnce impl for &mut Drain; the referent is not callable, so the reference keeps its own impl candidate and Self::Output is U

output-mismatch.rs.reason: opponent: the user impl's Output normalizes to u16 and is returned as u8 (E0308)

reference-without-impl.rs.reason: opponent: &mut Plain has neither a callable referent nor an impl, so its Output does not exist (E0277)
